subject: [PATCH v3 06/11] mm, swap: write back vswap zswap entries to physical swap

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch adds support for writing back zswap-backed vswap entries to physical swap, mirroring the existing zswap writeback path but allocating a physical slot on demand at writeback time rather than pre-allocating it. It also relaxes the zswap shrinker gate by replacing a blanket check with can_zswap_writeback(), which only skips when no physical slot is free to allocate. This allows the shrinker to drain vswap entries when physical swap is available.
